## 📍 Location

Section, page, line, equation, figure, or table this concerns (e.g., Sec. 3, eq.
(4), figure 2).

## 🎯 Issue

What is wrong, unclear, missing, or could be improved?

> _Ex: "The assumption behind eq. (4) is not stated, so the result in Sec. 4
> looks stronger than it is."_

## 💡 Proposed Change

Describe the change, or suggest the new text:

```latex
% Suggested replacement text
```

## 🔗 Source or Evidence

If applicable, give the reference, derivation, run, or referee comment that
supports the change.

## ⚠️ Additional Context

Add any other context here (e.g., whether this blocks submission).
